label_contract.strong: Fraction of segment characters overlapping mapped CNKI strong spans.
label_contract.possible: Fraction overlapping mapped CNKI possible-only spans; disjoint from strong.
label_contract.review_target: strong + possible; output possible-only must exclude output strong.
label_contract.unmarked: CNKI comparator-unmarked; not verified human authorship.
label_contract.controls: Both human controls are user-confirmed; identity is fitting metadata, never a runtime feature.
label_contract.unit_memberships: Every paragraph unit intersecting the segment, with intersecting prose character counts. Counts exclude paragraph separators and may sum to less than chars. Use these memberships for grouped diagnostics; unit is only legacy midpoint metadata.
label_contract.chapter_holdout: For each held chapter, exclude every intersecting multi-unit segment from training and testing. Test only single-unit held-chapter segments; record purged segments and excluded comparator characters.
label_contract.intervals: Zero-based half-open Python Unicode offsets; union counts prevent duplicate labels.
label_contract.scope: Frozen current continuous prose, excluding headings and captions; not the provider full-document denominator.
